description:
List comments on your connected social accounts — recent comments across the account (omit postId) or comments on a specific post (pass postId).

Supported platforms: facebook, instagram, youtube, linkedin, threads, bluesky, google-business. (tiktok, telegram, twitter, pinterest are NOT engagement platforms.)

postId semantics per platform: media id (instagram/facebook), video id (youtube), post URN (linkedin), thread id (threads), post URI (bluesky). google-business does not support postId (reviews are location-level, not per-post).

Each returned comment carries an id and a platformData blob. For bluesky, platformData.replyRefs holds the four AT-Protocol refs (parentUri, parentCid, rootUri, rootCid) that reply_to_comment needs — surface them when replying. google-business comments are customer reviews; platformData.starRating carries the 1-5 rating; replying to an already-replied review overwrites the existing reply.

accountId.description: Specific connected account id. Omit to use the first connected account for the platform.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor.

platform.description: Engagement platform: facebook, instagram, youtube, linkedin, threads, bluesky, or google-business.

postId.description: Optional. Fetch comments on this specific post instead of recent comments. Platform-specific: media id (instagram/facebook), video id (youtube), post URN (linkedin), thread id (threads), post URI (bluesky).

name: list_comments
title: List Comments
